failure.errorSummary: Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use :::3000
rawLogLines: Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use :::3000

fix.description: Configure the dev script to fallback to port 3001 or kill the stale process occupying port 3000
conceptExplanation: EADDRINUSE occurs when another active process (or a previous unkilled zombie process) is already bound to that TCP port.
You can either kill the process holding port 3000 or pass a distinct port flag to your dev server.
fix.whyFixWorks: Changes the dev command to bind to port 3001 to bypass the port collision immediately.

verification.description: Start the development server on the new port to verify startup succeeds.

failure.errorSummary: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at unix:///var/run/docker.sock. Is the docker daemon running?
rawLogLines: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at unix:///var/run/docker.sock. Is the docker daemon running?

fix.description: Start the system Docker daemon service
conceptExplanation: The Docker CLI communicates with dockerd through a Unix domain socket.
When the Docker service is inactive or not started on boot, commands fail to establish socket connection.
fix.whyFixWorks: Starts the Docker daemon via systemctl so the client can communicate over the unix socket.
fix.diff:
--- a/command
+++ b/command
@@ -1 +1 @@
-docker compose up -d
+sudo systemctl start docker && docker compose up -d

verification.description: Check Docker daemon status and connectivity.

failure.errorSummary: Updates were rejected because the remote contains work that you do not have locally.
rawLogLines: error: failed to push some refs to 'https://github.com/org/repo.git'
hint: Updates were rejected because the remote contains work that you do not
hint: have locally. This is usually caused by another repository pushing to
hint: the same ref. You may want to first integrate the remote changes

fix.description: Rebase local commits on top of the latest upstream remote branch changes
conceptExplanation: Git protects remote history from being overwritten when your local branch diverges from the upstream branch.
Pulling with rebase integrates remote commits first, cleanly applying local commits on top.
fix.whyFixWorks: Resolves divergence without creating superfluous merge commits.
fix.diff:
--- a/workflow
+++ b/workflow
@@ -1 +1 @@
-git push origin main
+git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin main

verification.description: Fetch upstream refs and replay commits on top cleanly.

fix.description: Add pydantic to requirements.txt and install missing package into virtual environment
conceptExplanation: Python scripts require third-party libraries to be installed in the active environment/site-packages.
Declaring explicit package pins in requirements.txt guarantees consistent reproducibility.
fix.whyFixWorks: Ensures the pydantic module is installed and discoverable by the Python interpreter.

verification.description: Install dependencies and execute the script help flag.

fix.description: Grant execute permission (+x) to the deploy shell script
conceptExplanation: POSIX filesystems require the execute bit (x) set on executable scripts when running them directly.
New files or checked-out files often lack executable mode flags by default.
fix.whyFixWorks: Adds executable rights using chmod +x so the shell can directly run the file.

verification.description: Add executable permission and run in dry-run mode.

title: Rust Borrow Checker (E0382 Use of Moved Value)

fix.description: Pass a reference (&buffer) or clone the string before passing to process_buffer
conceptExplanation: Rust enforces strict ownership; passing a non-Copy type by value transfers ownership away.
Using a shared reference `&buffer` allows downstream functions to read without consuming the instance.
fix.whyFixWorks: Borrows the String instead of taking full ownership, keeping `buffer` valid for the subsequent println! call.

verification.description: Run compiler checks without building artifacts to confirm ownership passes.

failure.errorSummary: PrismaClientInitializationError: Can't reach database server at localhost:5432
rawLogLines: PrismaClientInitializationError: Can't reach database server at `localhost:5432`
Please make sure your database server is running at `localhost:5432`.

fix.description: Correct DATABASE_URL host from localhost to 127.0.0.1 or start local postgres service
conceptExplanation: Node.js DNS resolution may resolve 'localhost' to IPv6 (::1) where PostgreSQL is only listening on IPv4 (127.0.0.1).
Specifying the explicit IPv4 loopback avoids connection refusal when dual-stack bindings differ.
fix.whyFixWorks: Directly targets IPv4 loopback address 127.0.0.1 where the database engine is bound.

verification.description: Run migrations against explicit database host.

failure.errorSummary: missing go.sum entry for module providing package github.com/gin-gonic/gin
rawLogLines: cmd/api/main.go:5:2: missing go.sum entry for module providing package github.com/gin-gonic/gin (imported by github.com/app/go-service/cmd/api);

fix.description: Tidy dependencies and record missing checksums in go.sum
conceptExplanation: Go modules enforce cryptographic checksum verification recorded in `go.sum`.
When imports are introduced without updating checksums, the compiler refuses to build.
fix.whyFixWorks: Runs `go mod tidy` to prune unused packages and record hashes for all imported dependencies.
fix.diff:
--- a/workflow
+++ b/workflow
@@ -1 +1 @@
-go run ./cmd/api
+go mod tidy && go run ./cmd/api

verification.description: Ensure module checksums are synchronized and package tests pass.

failure.errorSummary: FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory
rawLogLines: FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory

fix.description: Increase maximum old space memory limit via NODE_OPTIONS flag
conceptExplanation: Node.js enforces a default heap memory ceiling (~2GB to ~4GB depending on architecture).
Large bundle generation or type-checking can temporarily exceed the default heap limit.
fix.whyFixWorks: Allocates 8192 MB (8GB) heap ceiling to accommodate the compilation phase without crashing.

verification.description: Execute build script with the increased heap allocation.

failure.errorSummary: Failed to pull image 'registry.internal/api:latest': rpc error: code = NotFound desc = failed to pull and unpack image
rawLogLines: Warning  Failed     3s (x2 over 15s)  kubelet  Failed to pull image "registry.internal/api:latest": rpc error: code = NotFound
Warning  Failed     3s (x2 over 15s)  kubelet  Error: ErrImagePull
Normal   BackOff    1s (x3 over 14s)  kubelet  Back-off pulling image "registry.internal/api:latest"
Warning  Failed     1s (x3 over 14s)  kubelet  Error: ImagePullBackOff

fix.description: Fix invalid container image tag and specify existing semver tag
conceptExplanation: ImagePullBackOff indicates the kubelet cannot download the target container image from the registry.
Using untagged or non-existent ':latest' tags in private registries fails authentication or image lookup.
fix.whyFixWorks: Points the pod spec to a verified, published image version tag in the container registry.
fix.diff:
--- a/deployment.yaml
+++ b/deployment.yaml
@@ -18,3 +18,3 @@
     spec:
       containers:
-      - image: registry.internal/api:latest
+      - image: registry.internal/api:v1.4.2

verification.description: Verify the pods transition successfully to Running state.
